name: MCP governance move to the Agentic AI Foundation
note: Anthropic donated MCP 2025-12-09 to the AAIF under the Linux Foundation, co-founded with Block and OpenAI. Alex already consumes 13 MCP servers and serves one (Application Engine MCP since 2026-07-01). No action needed; recorded so the governance fact is banked.

name: n8n-nodes-a2a npm name collision
note: The npm package n8n-nodes-a2a is Account-to-Account BANK TRANSFERS, not Agent2Agent. Installing it looking for agent interop would be a real mistake. Recorded so the trap is not re-discovered.
